card.title: The Winner’s Ceremony
card.instruction: Treat every contest, bargain, or decision as incomplete until the proper recognition, ritual, and consequence have occurred.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before the next hand of cards, we need the winner's handshake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And we've recognised only five. This is how records become unreliable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A nod will do if you make it ceremonial.

mechanism: A makes each card victory require a recorded recognition ritual before play resumes.
confusable: Unlike wanting praise generally, a missing ritual must leave the sequence of results incomplete.
comparison: S211-b accommodates a tired hand by changing the ritual form; S211-a absorbs an impatient official into the ceremony.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
